versions.changelog:
js-comfyui-client v1.2.0

- Major update: Improved support for ComfyUI image and video generation workflows, bundled with common workflows and enhanced prompt/image node handling.
- Provides commands to load workflows, modify prompts, submit tasks, poll for results, and auto-download images/videos.
- Added detailed guidance for using txt2img, img2img (ControlNet, Qwen edit), and video generation, including workflow and node selection.
- Bundled 5 ready-to-use workflows for common generation scenarios (Z-Image, Qwen Edit, Wan Video etc.).
- Improved flexibility: supports multi-image editing, auto-detect prompt nodes, and session-based output organization.
- Expanded documentation with use cases, CLI reference, troubleshooting, and environment setup instructions.
